title: The AI Portfolio Mistake That Kills Your Job Chances 2026
description:
Why does your AI engineering portfolio make you look like everyone else? If it's full of a chatbot, a RAG demo, and an agent that summarizes articles, you blend in — these are the AI equivalent of a to-do list or weather app. They show you can follow a tutorial, but not that you can actually think.

The projects that stand out solve real problems: build an AI tool for the workflow of your current job, automate something tedious in an industry you understand, or solve a problem you personally have and ship it so others can use it too. 

It doesn't need to be groundbreaking — it's usually better if it's simple. It just needs to be real.

#techwithtim #aiengineer #learntocode #programming

top_reply.text: Stop doing projects you don’t like, it will show up in your work. Do something you actually like, CS or not, everyone can tell when you don’t like what you do whether you can tell or not. My first project was a simple platformee video game in greenfoot, learned Java, went on from there. If you don’t like CS and programing that’s totally fine, but don’t give up before you get that “ah ha” moment. You’re “why” is the most important factor—find yours.
